note: for a height in metres, the earliest year the assessor's roll dates ANY building at least that tall, counting only the footprints dated by their OWN parcel. A footprint whose year was borrowed from its block (FLAG_BLOCKYEAR) is drawn no earlier than the floor its own height implies. This dates nothing: it refuses what the register makes impossible.

source.publisher: San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder / DataSF
source.dataset: property roll wv5m-vpq2, joined to footprints ynuv-fyni
source.derived_from: the 142,679 footprints dated by their own parcel, of 166,166

applies_to: FLAG_BLOCKYEAR, bit 3 of the bldg chunk's `u` byte
not_fixed: the 259 m structure first drawn in 1917 carries that year on its OWN parcel roll and no flag, so nothing here touches it — and it is what holds this floor at 1917.
